systems.owner: Ministry of Internal Affairs, with the ministries and agencies whose services they deliver
systems.tiers: county level; assessed by Naymote in Bong, Grand Bassa and Margibi in July-August and November 2025

note: A civil-society tracker of the national development plan. It says county governments are under-resourced, with limited infrastructure and equipment, and that 89.3% of services at three County Service Centers still need in-person submission and live signatures, but it states nothing about a data connection at a county administration's own office; the service centres are one-stop shops for ministries' services.
